pros: Guard protects allies while leaving their own actions free.
DEF contributes to both a self Barrier and her main attack.
Maximum Leap turns a defensive refresh into an extra-turn opportunity.

abilities.name: Screw Breaker

abilities.label: Passive

pros: Ordinary Burn and Recovery Down give some utility beyond direct damage.
Two cooldown-reduction milestones improve both main attacks.
Blossom adds a distinct crit/turn-progress loop and a broken-target payoff.
The ordinary ultimate supplies two-turn ATK Up for subsequent damage.
cons: Ordinary speed and anti-heal effects depend on crits and last only one turn.
No team heal, cleanse, barrier or area damage.
Blossom benefits require separate investment and cannot justify ordinary first-copy expectations.
play: For ordinary Marcille, use Screw Breaker to establish ATK Up, then Nail Drive to apply Burn and attempt the crit-based SPD buff when ready.

For Blossom only: use cooldown attacks to build Fractured Nut, check the three-stack start-of-turn conversion into Hex Nut, and spend Hex Nut on a useful hit, ideally into Toughness Break.
